title: Beehive kiln
mechanism: Brick dome, natural draft. Ore by a wooden chute into the top hopper, coal into the firebox, the tap door lifts and the ingot slides onto the stone tray.

title: Indirect-fired rotary kiln
mechanism: Validated base. Shaft port and gearbox drive the drum, a row of flames under the drum, gravity coal chute at the back, folding discharge chute.

title: Forge line
mechanism: Reheating furnace, live rollers on a chain, wooden cam log with a big gear lifting the drop hammer, two-high rolling mill on a chain, plates into a bin.

title: Induction carousel
mechanism: Motor pinion on a ring gear indexes four crucibles: hopper, water-cooled induction coils, tilting pour into the mold.

title: Alloy crucible carousel
mechanism: Vertical shaft from the top port drives the carousel: copper hopper, tin hopper, coal-fired brick hood, tilting pour of bronze.

title: Particle ring
mechanism: Twelve magnets in a circle on a ceramic base, kicker and injection line, ore levitating and melting in a glass chamber.
